history.answer: Yes. The recovery code on your receipt moves your purchase to up to 5 devices, so pay on one and open it on the other.

history.answer: Reach Prepared, sit the real exam within 21 days of paying and fail, and email refund@howardslantern.com a photo of your result with your recovery code.
